translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Biittaa bazzuunne mela biittay nashettana; Mela biittay nashshechchaa pooc'u giidde, c'iishshaa c'iishshaana.

I daroppe c'iishshaana; pooc'u giide nashshechchan yes's'ana. Liibaanoosa bonchchuunne K'armmeloosanne Saaroona gitatetsay imettana; unttunttu Med'inaa Godaa bonchchuwaanne nu S'oossaa gitatetsaa be'ana.
Wozanaan yashshay de'iyaawantta, «Minnite! Yayyoppite! Hekko, hintte S'oossay haluwaa kessanawunne bare s'oossatetsan unttuntta muranaw yaana; I hinttena ashshana» yaagite.
He wode, k'ook'etuwaa ayfii dooyettana; tulletuwaa haytsaykka sisana.
Wobbatuwaa gen"iyaadan guppana; duudetuukka nashshechchan yes's'ana; bazzuwaan haatsay melosaan pulttuu d'uuk'k'ana.
S'uuggiyaa shafii dagatteedda haatsaa gidanawaa; mela biittay haatsaa pulttana; worakanatuu allas's'iyaasan maatay mak'k'aynne c'arii dolana.
Yan aakko ogii de'ana; ikka Geeshshatetsaa Ogiyaa geetettana. Geeshsha gidennawanttu he ogiyaanna aad'd'ikkino. Shin I geeshshatuwaassa gidanawaa; iita eeyyatuu aan simerettikkino.
Yan gaammuu de'enna; yashshiyaa do'atuukka hewaana aad'd'ikkino; yaanikka beettikkino; shin wozetteeddawanttu s'alalay hamettana.

Med'inaa Goday wozeeddawanttu simmana; yes's'iiddi, S'iyoone yaana; med'inaa nashechchay unttunttu huup'iyaan wod'd'ana. Unttunttu nashshechchaanne hashshu giyaawaa demmana; kayyuunne oolii wora bak'atana.
